messages:
tanya: quick sync — minor keystore rotation + base-image rebuild next wed. Need RBAC lock and audit sink.
ricardo: which clusters? prod only?
tanya: prod + staging. Keep old key v1 active for 48h and mark deprecated.
zlata: RBAC: will scope roles/cloudkms.signer to serviceAccount:cosign-signer@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com and add a resource.name condition to limit to the cosign key path.
infra-bot: policy-check: recommended condition -> resource.name.startsWith("projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/prod/cryptoKeys/cosign").
ricardo: ops notes: prefetch KMS tokens on nodes, extend image pull secret TTL by 10m to avoid parallel evictions during rotation.
tanya: audit sink: forward AsymmetricSign/AsymmetricVerify and IAM policy changes to gs://audit-keystore-weekly with 90d retention. ricardo pls add alert for >2 sign errors / 5m.
zlata: I'll open RBAC PR with diff and include example commands: `gcloud kms keys add-iam-policy-binding cosign --location global --keyring prod --member=serviceAccount:cosign-signer@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com --role=roles/cloudkms.signer`
security-bot: advisory: previous wide grants found; tighten bindings before rotation.
tanya: canary window Tue 03:30-04:30 UTC. sre-oncall please ack.
infra-bot: alert-config: monitor keystore-sign-errors created -> notify @sre-oncall.
ricardo: sg, oncall will watch. If KMS permission errors appear we pause and revert to old key version.
tanya: thanks all. PR link and runbook when ready; will post here.
